heading.en: Two heads are better than one

hook.en: A good mechanic has skill but no money; his friend has money but no time. Together they can open a garage. That agreement is a partnership.
hook.kn: ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಮೆಕ್ಯಾನಿಕ್‌ಗೆ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯವಿದೆ ಆದರೆ ಹಣವಿಲ್ಲ; ಅವನ ಗೆಳೆಯನಿಗೆ ಹಣವಿದೆ ಆದರೆ ಸಮಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಅವರು ಗ್ಯಾರೇಜ್ ತೆರೆಯಬಹುದು. ಆ ಒಪ್ಪಂದವೇ ಪಾಲುದಾರಿಕೆ.

objectives.en: Define partnership and state its features
Identify types of partners and partnerships
Explain the partnership deed and registration

narration.en: A good mechanic has skill but no money; his friend has money but no time. Together they can open a garage. That agreement is a partnership.
narration.kn: ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಮೆಕ್ಯಾನಿಕ್‌ಗೆ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯವಿದೆ ಆದರೆ ಹಣವಿಲ್ಲ; ಅವನ ಗೆಳೆಯನಿಗೆ ಹಣವಿದೆ ಆದರೆ ಸಮಯವಿಲ್ಲ. ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ಅವರು ಗ್ಯಾರೇಜ್ ತೆರೆಯಬಹುದು. ಆ ಒಪ್ಪಂದವೇ ಪಾಲುದಾರಿಕೆ.

body.en: The Indian Partnership Act, 1932 defines partnership as the relation between persons who have agreed to share the profits of a business carried on by all or any of them acting for all. It is formed by agreement, partners have unlimited and joint and several liability, and each partner is an agent of the others (mutual agency). It needs at least 2 members; the prescribed maximum is 50.

narration.en: The Indian Partnership Act, 1932 defines partnership as the relation between persons who have agreed to share the profits of a business carried on by all or any of them acting for all. It is formed by agreement, partners have unlimited and joint and several liability, and each partner is an agent of the others (mutual agency). It needs at least 2 members; the prescribed maximum is 50.
narration.kn: ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಲಾಭ ಹಂಚಿಕೊಳ್ಳಲು ಒಪ್ಪಿದ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಗಳ ನಡುವಿನ ಸಂಬಂಧವೇ ಪಾಲುದಾರಿಕೆ. ಇದು ಒಪ್ಪಂದದಿಂದ ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತದೆ; ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಅಪರಿಮಿತ; ಕನಿಷ್ಠ 2, ಗರಿಷ್ಠ 50 ಪಾಲುದಾರರು.

body.en: Partners can be active, sleeping or dormant, secret, nominal, partner by estoppel, or partner by holding out. A minor can be admitted only to the benefits of the firm, with the consent of all partners, and his liability is limited to his share. By duration a partnership is at will or particular; by liability it is general or limited.

body.en: A partnership deed is the written agreement that states the firm's name, nature of business, capital, profit-sharing ratio, interest on capital and drawings, duties of partners and the terms of admission and retirement. Registration with the Registrar of Firms is optional, but an unregistered firm cannot sue third parties, and a partner cannot sue the firm or other partners. If there is no deed, profits are shared equally.

points.en: Deed: written agreement on key terms
Unregistered firm cannot sue third parties

problem.en: Priya, Imran and Joseph run a firm without a deed. Capitals are ₹3,00,000, ₹2,00,000 and ₹1,00,000. Profit is ₹90,000. How is it shared?

steps.en: There is no partnership deed, so the Partnership Act's rule applies: profits are shared equally.
Capital ratio 3:2:1 is NOT used for profit sharing here.
